prompt.STACK: C# (.NET 10) + ASP.NET Core + Entity Framework Core + SQLite
prompt.WORKERS: Kestrel with the default .NET thread pool (scales with the core count)

scanner.name: dotnet
argv: p=$(find . \( -name bin -o -name obj \) -prune -o \( -name "*.sln" -o -name "*.slnx" \) -print | sort | head -1); [ -n "$p" ] || p=$(find . \( -name bin -o -name obj \) -prune -o -name "*.csproj" ! -name "*Test*" -print | sort | head -1); [ -n "$p" ] || { echo "no .sln/.slnx/.csproj" >&2; exit 2; }; dotnet restore "$p" 1>&2 && dotnet list "$p" package --vulnerable --include-transitive --format json
